description: A researcher-built, 40-item multiple-choice vocabulary test drawn from Coxhead's Academic Word List and developed by Minoo Alemi and colleagues to assess upper-intermediate university students' academic word knowledge.
title: 40-item multiple-choice Academic Word List vocabulary test (Cronbach's alpha = .89)

description: A researcher-developed, validity- and reliability-checked 40-item four-option multiple-choice assessment for measuring second-grade Arabic listening, speaking, reading, and writing achievement.
title: 40-item multiple-choice Arabic achievement test

description: A researcher-developed 40-item, four-option mathematics assessment administered before and after instruction to measure undergraduate students’ mathematics achievement and problem-solving ability.
title: 40-item multiple-choice pre-test and post-test instrument for mathematics learning achievement and problem solving ability

description: A study-developed checklist for independently rating medical students' videotaped shoulder examinations across anatomical knowledge, clinical examination skills, and professionalism.
title: 40-item video-based shoulder examination checklist with blinded dual rating
